quest.title: Wooden Hilichurl Nest
quest.description: Fanmu has been overtaken by Hilichurls. The Master of Fanmu is seeking people to help him...

talks.objective: Defeat all hilichurls at Fanmu Carpenter's
Talk to the owner of the carpentry workshop

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: I welcome you to the Fanmu Carpenter's, one of the longest-running carpentry workshops in Qingce Village! You name it, I build it, whether it's a yo-yo or a new house!

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: No, of course not. My workshop is up that hill over there.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: But from time to time it gets overrun by monsters, and they mess the place up.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: I tried getting some strapping young lads from The Millelith to help, but every time they approached, the monsters would make a run for it. Of course, then they return as soon as the lads leave...

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: There's no way I can get any meaningful work done in the workshop with all this going on... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: You're leaving? Do be careful those monsters don't get you.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: *sigh* Whatever am I to do about the workshop...
